semiconductor_relevance: High — RECIF Technologies specializes in robotic handling equipment specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: RECIF Technologies designs, manufactures, and distributes fully automated atmospheric handling equipment for the semiconductor industry. They focus on providing solutions for wafer handling, particularly for 300mm silicon wafers and advanced packaging substrates, ensuring compliance with SEMI standards.
capabilities: Robotic handling systems for semiconductor wafers
Support for 3D-IC and FO-WLP packaging substrates

regional_presence.United States: RECIF Technologies has established a presence in the USA to support its global customer base.
regional_presence.Asia: The company is also active in the Asian market, ensuring accessibility to key electronic industry regions.
